notes: Company: multi-tenant SaaS platform for conversational agents (B2B). Customers embed agents into their product via SDK.
Primary evaluation path: Hosted API -> short hosted POC -> evaluate Dedicated for predictable throughput and isolated quotas.
Key metrics: 95th pct latency target <= 350ms (token streaming enabled), sustained 1200 concurrent streams across tenants in pilot, per-tenant QPS and token quotas.
POC goals: measure streaming stability (no reconnects >1% of sessions), verify function/tool-calling latency under load, confirm prefix caching behavior for repeated prompts.
Security: need SSO/SAML for admin console, audit logs for calls, KMS integration for secrets. Asked about data residency for EU customers (they have EU customers).
Pricing sensitivity: middle-ground — willing to pay premium for predictable latency and guaranteed isolation, but unit economics must be under $0.002/token for heavy inference paths.
Quote from Product Lead: "We can't have noisy neighbors — per-tenant throttles must be enforceable and predictable. If Hosted can't guarantee that, Dedicated is the fallback."
Engineering note (SE): streaming stability observations — small rebuffer events at 200 concurrent streams during demo; needs longer load-run to be confident.
Requested artifacts: latency SLA language, per-tenant quota docs, example canary/rollout policy, pricing for burst capacity and reserved slots.
Decision criteria checklist: latency SLO, streaming reliability, quota isolation, pricing predictability, SSO/compliance answers, on-boarding time
